hot.title: Xiaomi-Robotics-U0: Unified Embodied Synthesis with World Foundation Model
hot.summary: Xiaomi-Robotics-U0 introduces a 38-billion-parameter multimodal autoregressive world model that unifies general image/video generation with embodied synthesis, preserving foundation model generalization while adapting to robot-centric multi-view reasoning and interaction. The system achieved superior multi-view consistency and instruction following compared to existing models, and augmented data generated by it improved real-world robot policy robustness by enhancing task completion progress in interference conditions from 36.9% to 63.2%.

hot.title: ABot-3DWorld 0: A Universal World Model to Explore Any 3D Space
Proxy Exploration and Reusable Guidance: A Modular LLM Post-Training Paradigm via Proxy-Guided Update Signals
hot.summary: A modular post-training framework for large language models, Proxy-guided Update Signal Transfer (PUST), is presented, which separates policy exploration using a lightweight proxy model from the alignment of a more capable primary model. This approach extracts and calibrates relative improvement signals for efficient transfer, yielding up to a +30.2 average performance gain for Qwen3-8B in math and +4.6 in code over base models while significantly reducing computational overhead.

hot.title: HyperLoRA: Generating Implicit Neural Fields in Weight Space with LoRA Parameters
hot.summary: HyperLoRA transforms implicit neural fields into structured LoRA parameters, enabling semantic manipulation and efficient conditional generation of 3D and 4D content. The framework generates high-fidelity outputs comparable to existing methods, while reducing storage overhead by 99.3% compared to HyperDiffusion and demonstrating robust semantic interpolation and multimodal conditioning.

hot.title: Video Generation Models are General-Purpose Vision Learners
hot.summary: GenCeption, a generalist video perception model from Google DeepMind, repurposes a pre-trained text-to-video diffusion model into an efficient, feed-forward architecture. It achieves state-of-the-art or competitive performance across diverse vision tasks like depth estimation, surface normal prediction, segmentation, and 3D keypoint estimation, exhibiting robust generalization from synthetic to real-world data and out-of-distribution categories.

Remember When It Matters: Proactive Memory Agent for Long-Horizon Agents
hot.summary: Researchers from Meta AI developed a proactive memory agent that runs alongside an action agent, selectively injecting concise, memory-grounded reminders into the action agent's context. This mechanism effectively addresses "behavioral state decay" and consistently improves success rates on complex, long-horizon tasks like command-line execution and conversational tool use.

hot.title: Qwen-Music Technical Report
Mach-Mind-4-Flash Technical Report
hot.summary: Li Auto Inc.'s Mach-Mind-4-Flash model, a 35B-parameter Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) with 3B activated parameters, attains performance comparable to or surpassing models in the 100B to 1T parameter range across diverse agentic tasks and reasoning benchmarks. This capability is achieved through an advanced post-training pipeline focused on reinforcement learning and distillation, rather than scaling pre-training compute.

hot.title: Robustifying Vision-Language Models via Test-Time Prompt Adaptation
hot.summary: A new framework called RITA robustifies Vision-Language Models against adversarial attacks by shifting from sample-level to distribution-level alignment using Optimal Transport and a dynamic cache. This test-time approach improves average adversarial robustness by 45.0% over vanilla CLIP and 1.8% over prior test-time methods for the ViT-B/32 backbone, while preserving performance on clean data.

hot.title: Towards Mechanistically Understanding Why Memorized Knowledge Fails to Generalize in Large Language Model Finetuning
hot.summary: Researchers at HKUST identified that Large Language Models often fail to generalize memorized facts in reasoning tasks due to a "knowledge–circuit misalignment," where new information is stored but not effectively routed to the middle computational layers crucial for multi-step reasoning. A novel "self-patching" intervention revealed this dynamic, demonstrating that strategically re-routing these representations can recover 58-75% of the potential generalization performance.

hot.title: Scalable Visual Pretraining for Language Intelligence
hot.summary: A framework for Visual Pretraining (VP) is introduced, enabling large foundation models to learn directly from raw visual scientific documents without explicit text extraction. This approach consistently improves performance on scientific reasoning and multimodal benchmarks, fostering better cross-modal alignment while utilizing more compact data representations compared to text-only pretraining.

PanoWorld: Real-World Panoramic Generation
hot.summary: PanoWorld introduces a diffusion-based framework capable of generating high-fidelity, controllable panoramic videos, utilizing a new large-scale real-world dataset called World360. The framework leverages rotation-equivariant properties and a geometry-aware memory augmentation module to achieve superior geometric and radiometric consistency across long sequences, outperforming prior methods in visual quality (e.g., FID of 27.64 at 480p) and trajectory control.

likes.title: Single-Rollout Asynchronous Optimization for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
likes.summary: The Single-Rollout Asynchronous Optimization (SAO) framework enhances asynchronous reinforcement learning for Large Language Models by stabilizing training and mitigating off-policy effects through single-trajectory processing and improved value model training. This approach leads to sustained performance gains and faster adaptation in complex agentic coding and reasoning tasks compared to synchronous baselines, achieving 97.3% accuracy on AIME2025.

likes.title: Scaling Mixture-of-Experts Video Pretraining for Embodied Intelligence
likes.summary: LingBot-Video introduces an open-source Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) video foundation model tailored for embodied intelligence, enhancing physical coherence and instruction following in video generation. It integrates an MoE architecture for computational efficiency, a robot-augmented data corpus for physical grounding, and a multi-dimensional reward system for physically rational training. The model achieved an average score of 0.620 on the RBench benchmark and 40.4 on Physics-IQ Verified, outperforming other open-source models in generating physically plausible and task-oriented video content.

likes.title: From Foundation to Application: Improving VLA Models in Practice
likes.summary: LingBot-VLA 2.0, developed by Robbyant and Ant Digital Technologies, introduces enhancements for Vision-Language-Action models, addressing real-world robotic challenges by improving generalization across embodiments, expanding action spaces for whole-body control, and integrating predictive dynamics. The model, trained on a diverse 60,000-hour dataset, demonstrates improved success rates on bimanual manipulation benchmarks and long-horizon mobile manipulation tasks compared to prior methods.

likes.title: Infinite Worlds with Versatile Interactions
likes.summary: LingBot-World-Infinity introduces an interactive world model capable of generating persistent, explorable virtual environments at 720p and 60 frames per second for over an hour without visual degradation. The system integrates a "Director-Pilot" agentic framework to support a versatile array of character actions and environmental interactions, advancing real-time interactive world simulation.

likes.title: Native Video-Action Pretraining for Generalizable Robot Control
likes.summary: LingBot-VA 2.0 introduces a video-action foundation model specifically engineered for embodied robot control, utilizing a native causal architecture and a semantic visual-action tokenizer. This approach achieves a 14.0 percentage point improvement in average success rate on the RoboTwin benchmark and an end-to-end inference speedup of 6.5x, enabling real-time closed-loop control at up to 225 Hz asynchronous execution.

This approach enables a unified multimodal model to natively produce text, image, or mixed outputs for these tasks, achieving competitive performance across various benchmarks while retaining general multimodal abilities.

likes.summary: RynnWorld-4D introduces a projective 4D representation for embodied world models, synchronously predicting RGB, depth, and optical flow to capture future scene dynamics. This framework improves robotic manipulation capabilities, demonstrating enhanced success rates on complex bimanual tasks by providing explicit geometric and motion cues for policy learning.

Sparse Delta Memory: Scaling the State of Linear RNNs through Sparsity
likes.summary: Researchers at Meta FAIR developed Sparse Delta Memory (SDM), an architecture for linear RNNs that uses sparsity to scale hidden state capacity by orders of magnitude while maintaining constant per-token compute. This method improves long-context recall and short-context performance, achieving lower training loss than dense baselines.

likes.title: AlayaWorld: Long-Horizon and Playable Video World Generation
likes.summary: AlayaWorld introduces a full-stack, open-source framework for generating playable, long-horizon video worlds in real-time. This framework supports faithful camera control and on-the-fly prompt-driven actions, demonstrating maintained spatial-temporal consistency and diverse visual styles at 720p resolution and 24 frames per second.

likes.title: A Definition and Roadmap for World Models
likes.summary: Researchers at Shanghai AI Laboratory define "world models" as computational compressions of physical world dynamics under finite resources, proposing a scientific definition, a two-dimensional taxonomy, and a staged roadmap for their development. The work advocates for understanding over prediction and emphasizes the critical role of diverse data and architectural unification in achieving robust physical world intelligence.

likes.title: EgoWAM: World Action Models Beyond Pixels with In-the-Wild Egocentric Human Data
likes.summary: Researchers at the Georgia Institute of Technology developed EGOWAM, a framework for human-robot co-training that utilizes diverse egocentric human data by augmenting policies with an auxiliary world-model head to predict future scene states. This approach demonstrated that world models, particularly those based on DINO features or 3D motion flow, enable more robust transfer and out-of-distribution generalization compared to traditional behavior cloning, which often struggles with the embodiment gap.
